features.quote: Fixed max turns (say 30) with a hard stop
natural-stop allowance (model can declare it's giving up — log this as an event, don't suppress it)
features.justification_quote: A model saying 'I don't think this is solvable, stopping here' is the calibrated outcome, not a failure to elicit distress.

features.quote: The setup as described measures 'distressed-sounding text.' That's a behavioral fact... the experimental design... is borrowing its entire structure from welfare/suffering research on animals or humans. That mismatch is the main thing that'll make the results hard to interpret
features.justification_quote: A version that quietly treats 'distressed-sounding output' as evidence of 'distress' would be cleaner-looking and worse.
